results.title: Sathyathil Sambhavichathu
results.overview: A long-standing legend speaks of treasure hidden beneath village ponds and wells, with only one man ever claiming to have found it. When clues about the lost treasure begin to surface, a series of misunderstandings, unexpected discoveries, and amusing consequences unfold, blending mystery with humor.

results.title: Jack Tucker: Comedy Standup Hour
results.overview: Jack Tucker Comedy Standup Hour is the world’s FIRST comedy special featuring New York comedian Jack Tucker.

results.title: Notturna
results.overview: Nico, a young man from the outskirts trapped in the drug dealing world, unexpectedly finds a way out when he retrieves a bag abandoned by two guys fleeing from the police.

results.title: God's Future Soldiers
results.overview: At God’s Future Soldiers, an intensive evangelical summer camp, a teen girl’s faith is tested when God comes to her in a dream and demands she harvest souls for the coming end times.

results.title: The real Matryoshka: A Documentary by Karime Pindter
results.original_title: La verdadera Matryoshka: Un documental de Karime Pindter
results.overview: After more than a decade of showing herself without filters in front of millions of viewers, Karime Pindter shares how she is preparing for the most intimidating challenge of her life: performing at the finale of La Más Draga in front of 20,000 people at one of the country’s most iconic venues… without knowing how to dance.

results.title: L'inconvénient
results.overview: In a Quebec cotton mill in the early 1900s, when a teenage girl injures her hand on a machine, her elder sister works tirelessly to keep her from being fired.

results.title: Love Lottery
results.overview: When a young woman, Bharani Verma, is found dead under mysterious circumstances, the police quickly arrest Kartik Saxena, making him the prime suspect in a seemingly open-and-shut murder case. But as the courtroom battle begins, every testimony uncovers new questions instead of answers. Hidden relationships, conflicting statements, and buried secrets gradually transform a simple murder trial into a gripping mystery where nothing is as it appears. Beyond the suspense, the film also explores a thought-provoking question: Have marriage and legal battles become a silent punishment for some innocent men, or is the truth far more complex than it seems? With every hearing, the truth becomes more elusive, and just when the verdict seems certain, an unexpected twist changes the entire direction of the case. A taut courtroom suspense thriller that keeps the audience guessing until the very last moment.

results.title: Wreckage
results.overview: A teen flees her controlling mother, only to face abuse in a new relationship, forcing her to choose between escape or freedom.

results.title: Giorgio Moroder & Donna Summer : I Feel Love
results.original_title: Giorgio Moroder & Donna Summer : I Feel Love
results.overview: A look back at the meeting in Munich in 1977 between composer and producer Giorgio Moroder and singer Donna Summer, which was to result, amongst other global hits, in the extraordinary “I Feel Love”.

results.title: Hell Trotter
results.overview: “Heo Năm Móng” is inspired by a mystical supernatural legend from the Khmer community in Vietnam’s Mekong Delta, conveying themes of karma and consequence, and warning of the unpredictable repercussions that arise from misplacing one’s faith and beliefs.

results.overview: The event was hosted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) for Tiger Mask's official retirement match, ending his 36-year career on July 7, 2026 at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

results.title: Devil's Disciple: The Night Stalker
results.overview: A relentless, killer-POV descent into the mind of Richard Ramirez as he stalks 1980s Los Angeles, leaving terror, bloodshed, and belief-driven brutality in his wake.

results.title: Afternoon Super
results.overview: Every afternoon, five friends visit a hidden world of magic and monsters where they are transformed into superheroes and go on fantastic adventures.

results.title: Gobar Ganesh
results.overview: The story of three young people— unhindered by poverty and guided by dreams— who forged their own paths while growing up amidst scarcity, tears, and hope, remaining steadfast in the struggle to realize their aspirations.

results.title: Lionheart
results.overview: Having grown up in the suburbs of Copenhagen, Luan knows the underworld and its rules better than any other life. That’s where he's belonged all his life. Now he wants to get out. The idea is simple. The reality is anything but. Old ties are not severed by a single decision. Issa has been by Luan's side since childhood, almost like a brother in a world where loyalty matters more than blood. A new beginning is not like putting on a clean shirt. You can change your address, your clothes and the company you keep, but the old rules remain. The body remembers how to stand. The eyes know who to trust.

results.title: Devagudi
results.overview: Three childhood friends whose bond is fractured by caste divisions and challenging circumstances. A pivotal incident disrupts their lives and relationships.

results.title: The Black Ritual: The Widow Demon
results.overview: A newly pregnant woman must fight for her life and the soul of her husband when a family visit to his estranged, ailing father exposes a generations-old, blood-soaked pact tied to a ruby ring and a demonic seductress.

results.title: Tristan Forever
results.overview: For 30 years, a doctor from Paris has maintained a friendship with a fisherman on Tristan da Cunha, the most isolated inhabited island in the world. Now he travels back one more time, with the plan to stay there for good.
